html:
Luva is the map's spelling, in 1279 and 1300, for Lavo, the kingdom of Lopburi in central Thailand. Its earlier history is under Lopburi Kingdom.

In these years Khmer rule over Lavo was fading as the Khmer Empire weakened. Chinese records name embassies from Lavo to the Yuan court in the 1290s, as from the young Thai kingdom of Sukhothai under Ramkhamhaeng. Lavo's lands and its Khmer-style court culture then passed to Ayutthaya, founded in 1351 just to the south.
